spec.method: Keep released entries, prices and deadlines. Reconstruct released pre-override automaticChartContext at entry using causal v1 base and five-minute quote history. Reverse CALL/PUT only when marketShape is mixed-range; otherwise preserve it. Rescore against source quotes.
caveats: One already inspected external EUR/USD Forex day in 2020, not the user broker/OTC session, live accuracy or actual settlements.
The two video extractions describe one known source and must not be aggregated as independent sessions.
No inverse operations were executed and no production code or deployment was changed.
mixed-range means low directional efficiency away from historical extremes in this existing classifier. It does not establish periodic oscillation or the next turning point.
This audits the pre-override market context, not the final historical-level display label. No candidate runtime was deployed.
All these windows were already inspected before this hypothesis; this is exploratory, not independent validation.
